mapper.select: SELECT Or_ComCD , Or_Date , Or_Number , Or_Seq , Or_Flag , Or_Buser , Or_Prcode , Or_Occode = CASE WHEN ISNULL(Oc_Name, '') = '' THEN '' ELSE Or_Occode END , Or_ReSaCD = ISNULL(Or_ReSaCD, ''), Or_ReDt , Or_EmFlag , Or_Direct = ISNULL(Or_Direct, 'N') , Or_Prevqty , Or_PrevPrice , Or_Qty , Or_Price , Or_Remark , Or_OrderDate , Or_Cancel , Or_InDate , Or_InNumber , Or_Inqty , Or_InPrice , Or_OutDate , Or_Outqty , Or_OutPrice , Or_DeptCD , Or_ChtNo , Or_IoRemark , Or_UK , Or_ElecUK , Or_ImgNum , Or_UserID , Or_RegDate , Or_ModUID , Or_ModDt , Oc_Name = ISNULL(Oc_Name, Or_Occode), Oc_StanSize, Oc_Unit, Oc_ComPany, Oc_Inscode, cc_Prcode = Or_Prcode, cc_PaNM = dbo.GetPatNM (Or_ChtNo) FROM O_OSOrderList LEFT JOIN O_OSCode ON Oc_Code = Or_Occode WHERE Or_ComCD = #{orComCD} AND Or_Date = #{orDate} AND Or_number = #{orNumber}
